versions.changelog:
- Initial release of riley-market-data.
- Provides live macroeconomic data, financial rates, and developer ecosystem stats via simple GET calls.
- No API keys needed; pay per call using x402 (USDC on Base).
- Supports queries for country economic indicators, DeFi vs risk-free yield spreads, US Treasury data, and global public debt.
- Includes trending GitHub repos, npm download counts, and top Hacker News stories.
- Free endpoint previews and catalog available for all users.
